mapper.select: SELECT order_id AS orderId, order_no AS orderNo, user_id AS userId, order_status AS orderStatus, pay_amount AS payAmount, pay_expire_time AS payExpireTime, pay_time AS payTime, fulfillment_mode AS fulfillmentMode, payment_status AS paymentStatus FROM ticket_order WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT order_item_id AS orderItemId, order_id AS orderId, sku_id AS skuId, quantity AS quantity FROM order_item WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY order_item_id ASC
SELECT order_audience_id AS orderAudienceId, order_id AS orderId FROM order_audience WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY order_audience_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket_sku SET stock_locked = stock_locked - #{quantity}, sold_count = sold_count + #{quantity}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE sku_id = #{skuId} AND stock_locked >= #{quantity}

UPDATE ticket_order SET order_status = 'WAIT_USE', payment_status = CASE WHEN fulfillment_mode = 'TICKET_SOURCE' THEN 'PROVIDER_CONFIRMED' ELSE 'PAID' END, pay_method = #{payMethod}, pay_time = #{payTime}, update_time = #{payTime} WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND order_status = 'WAIT_PAY'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO electronic_ticket (ticket_no, order_id, order_item_id, order_audience_id, ticket_status, qr_code_value, seat_info, generate_time, check_time, expire_time, abnormal_reason, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{ticketNo}, #{orderId}, #{orderItemId}, #{orderAudienceId}, #{ticketStatus}, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, #{now}, #{now})
